metadata.question: On August 2, 2018, did the water temperature at Long Beach (33.601421, -118.089042) show a higher temperature anomaly, when compared to the long-term average for this time of year, than that observed at Pismo Beach (35.128348, -120.727924)?

data.raw_code: The user asks to compare water temperature anomalies at two beach locations on a specific date (August 2, 2018) against their respective long-term averages for that time of year. 1. Search Strategy: - Need water temperature data. MODIS Terra Sea Surface Temperature (SST) product (MOD28) provides daily SST at 1km resolution. - Time periods: - For 2018: Get image for August 2, 2018 (or nearby date within ±3 days) - For long-term average: Use multi-year average around same date (e.g., July 31-August 4) from 2000-2017 - Locations: Two points: Long Beach (33.601421, -118.089042) and Pismo Beach (35.128348, -120.727924) 2. Masking Strategy: - MODIS SST has quality flags. Should mask low-quality pixels (Quality_level < 2). - Also mask land pixels (SST = 0 or negative values). 3. Logic: - Compute SST at each point for 2018. - Compute long-term climatology (2000-2017 average for same ±2 day window). - Calculate anomaly = 2018_SST - long_term_SST. - Compare which anomaly is higher. - Need to handle cases where no data exists for 2018 or long-term period. Potential issues: - MODIS Terra daily SST available from 2000-03-01 onward. Should work. - Need to convert from Kelvin to Celsius for interpretation (scale factor 0.01). - Check for valid pixels after quality masking. Final answer: - If Long Beach anomaly > Pismo Beach anomaly: A - Else: B - Handle cases where data missing or invalid. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometries and dates const longBeach = ee.Geometry.Point(-118.089042, 33.601421); const pismoBeach = ee.Geometry.Point(-120.727924, 35.128348); const targetDate = '2018-08-02'; const targetWindow = 2; // days before/after for matching // 2. Function to mask low-quality SST pixels function maskSST(image) { const sst = image.select('sea_surface_temperature').multiply(0.01); // Convert to Kelvin const quality = image.select('Quality_level'); // Mask low quality (0=bad, 1=acceptable, 2=good, 3=best) const mask = quality.gte(2).and(sst.gt(0)); // Valid SST > 0K return sst.updateMask(mask); } // 3. Get 2018 SST for target date ±window const targetStart = ee.Date(targetDate).advance(-targetWindow, 'day'); const targetEnd = ee.Date(targetDate).advance(targetWindow, 'day'); const sst2018 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD28') .filterDate(targetStart, targetEnd) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2018, 2018, 'year')) .map(maskSST); // Check if 2018 data exists const sst2018Count = sst2018.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2018 SST images: ${sst2018Count}`); if (sst2018Count === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 4. Get long-term average (2000-2017) for same seasonal window const longTermStart = ee.Date(targetDate).advance(-targetWindow, 'day'); const longTermEnd = ee.Date(targetDate).advance(targetWindow, 'day'); const longTermSST = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD28') .filterDate('2000-01-01', '2017-12-31') .filter(ee.Filter.dayOfYear( longTermStart.get('day_of_year'), longTermEnd.get('day_of_year') )) .map(maskSST) .mean(); // 5. Get 2018 composite (mean of available images in window) const sst2018Composite = sst2018.mean(); // 6. Calculate anomalies at both points function getAnomaly(point, name) { // Get 2018 value const sst2018Val = sst2018Composite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: point, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sea_surface_temperature'); const sst2018CountPixels = sst2018Composite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: point, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sea_surface_temperature'); // Get long-term value const sstLongTermVal = longTermSST.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: point, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sea_surface_temperature'); const sstLongTermCountPixels = longTermSST.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: point, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sea_surface_temperature'); // Get values const sst2018 = sst2018Val.getInfo(); const sstLongTerm = sstLongTermVal.getInfo(); const count2018 = sst2018CountPixels.getInfo(); const countLongTerm = sstLongTermCountPixels.getInfo(); console.log(`${name} 2018 SST: ${sst2018 ? sst2018.toFixed(2) : 'N/A'} K (${count2018} pixels)`); console.log(`${name} Long-term SST: ${sstLongTerm ? sstLongTerm.toFixed(2) : 'N/A'} K (${countLongTerm} pixels)`); // Check for valid pixels if (count2018 === 0 || countLongTerm === 0) { console.log(`${name}: No valid pixels after masking`); return null; } // Calculate anomaly (2018 - long-term) const anomaly = sst2018 - sstLongTerm; console.log(`${name} Anomaly: ${anomaly.toFixed(2)} K`); return anomaly; } // 7. Get anomalies for both locations const anomalyLB = getAnomaly(longBeach, 'Long Beach'); const anomalyPB = getAnomaly(pismoBeach, 'Pismo Beach'); // 8. Validate and determine answer if (anomalyLB === null || anomalyPB === null) { console.log("C2"); return; } if (isNaN(anomalyLB) || isNaN(anomalyPB) || Math.abs(anomalyLB) > 20 || Math.abs(anomalyPB) > 20) { // Unreasonable SST anomaly console.log("C3"); return; } // 9. Compare anomalies console.log(`Long Beach anomaly: ${anomalyLB.toFixed(2)} K`); console.log(`Pismo Beach anomaly: ${anomalyPB.toFixed(2)} K`); if (anomalyLB > anomalyPB) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
